coaching.coaching: Today's 7 km at 8:13/km kept your average HR at 153 bpm, safely under the MAF ceiling of 155 bpm, which is solid. However, the pace is a bit slower than your target range (7:50–8:10) and the peak HR of 161 bpm suggests brief intensity spikes you should smooth out.
coaching.trend: Your recent runs show good HR control, mostly staying at or below 155 bpm, but pace varies from 8:36 to 7:34/km. Consistency is improving, though occasional HR spikes (e.g., 156 bpm on 8/17) need attention.
coaching.nextRun: Run 8 km at a target pace of 7:55–8:05/km, keep HR ≤ 154 bpm, and focus on maintaining a cadence around 176–180 spm with ground contact time under 280 ms.
